60062.name: Ballistic Calibration II
60062.SpecificEffects:
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+6%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+3%</color>.

RelatedDescription: This backpack incorporates a special combat-support chip and an all-in-one control unit to enhance the ST's destructive power at Ideal Range.
